title: Message/queryChanges has no maxChanges cap — can return unbounded result set
description: Message/queryChanges accepts a maxChanges parameter but does not enforce it — it returns all qualifying messages regardless. Under RFC 8620 §5.6 maxChanges must be enforced server-side; returning more than maxChanges changes in one response violates the spec and can cause OOM for large histories. Fix: apply the same truncation pattern used in Message/changes.
